purpose: M12b web explainer: source-grounded facts, not a calibration dataset
status: All four generic runtime profiles are P placeholders; no named television is calibrated.

units.internal_rgb: float32 linear-light RGB in nit-scaled units
units.apl: mean linear BT.709 luminance in nits; not mean PQ code

order: panel transmission/emission (opt-in angular terms here), matrix and illustrative mosaic
pipeline.sequence_insertion: Opt-in off/repeat/analytic sequence reconstruction occurs after per-source decode+spatial processing and before display stages, once per output tick.

output.run_linear: Frame containing float32 linear RGB nits before preview encoding

caveats: Not a fully coupled electro-optical power solver.
Ambient precedes temporal in the compatibility pipeline; use zero lux for emission/BFI demonstrations.
The Frame has no primaries tag and identity profile matrices are not complete BT.2020/panel gamut management.

generic_ips_edge.name: generic_ips_edge
generic_ips_edge.description: Placeholder edge-lit IPS set. Native contrast is lower than VA, viewing angle is wider, and the backlight is a single row of segments whose light is spread by a wide PSF. Each segment drives a full-height column before the blur; that is a stand-in, not a light-guide simulation.

generic_qdoled.name: generic_qdoled
generic_qdoled.description: Placeholder QD-OLED. The triangular subpixel buffer is a geometric stand-in that box-filters back to the source color. A little per-pixel PSF stands in for optical crosstalk. Quantum-dot spectra and a real gamut matrix are not modeled; color_matrix stays identity.

generic_va_fald_miniled.name: generic_va_fald_miniled
generic_va_fald_miniled.description: Placeholder VA mini-LED FALD set. Contrast is high on axis and falls off quickly with angle. Zone grid and PSF are round numbers, not a zone map from a shipping set.

generic_woled.name: generic_woled
generic_woled.description: Placeholder WOLED. Emission is per pixel (no zone grid). The WRGB mosaic is energy-preserving when box-filtered, so it does not change a flat color. ABL pulls the allowed peak down toward the full-field figure as APL rises. Spectral white-subpixel mixing beyond that mosaic is not modeled.

subpixels.evidence: P geometry; observed technology topology from research, exact apertures NR
subpixels.rgb_stripe: Separate R/G/B stripe apertures; panel-specific RGB/BGR order and domain geometry are not measured.
subpixels.wrgb: White-emitting OLED plus filtered R/G/B and an unfiltered W aperture; family order varies by generation.
subpixels.qdoled: Blue OLED plus patterned red/green quantum-dot conversion, blue retained; TV examples use green-above-red/blue staggered triangular topology.

macro.logical_pitch: same square logical pixel pitch for every family
macro.normalization: Each aperture has unit cell-mean; box averaging recovers input RGB.
macro.limits: Not a measured micrograph, spectrum, emitter peak or PenTile pixel-sharing model. Macro allocation differs from coarse pipeline mosaic.

derived_65_in_4k.evidence: D using nominal active diagonal and square 3840×2160 raster

grid.evidence: P current VA profile; not a shipping-TV zone map

edge_proxy.evidence: P full-height strips, not a measured edge-light guide

local_dimming.demand: max(R,G,B), pooled by zone maximum when percentile=100
local_dimming.transport: B_i = Σ_j H_ij d_j; current regular-grid approximation expands zone footprints then convolves unit-sum kernels
local_dimming.leakage: For B>0: L = clip(T, B/C, B), equivalent to compensated LCD transmission; current disabled-angle path uses 1e−8-nit numerical safe floor.

synthetic_example.evidence: D from synthetic inputs, not a measured halo

limits: No zone-controller lag, per-zone watt budget, measured influence matrix or iterative backlight/LCD solver.
Light spreading alone does not establish visible LCD halo; finite extinction raises dark pixels.
Current QD-OLED's 0.45-pixel PSF spreads emitted RGB; it is distinct from LCD zone leakage.

pq.evidence: D equation evaluation of pinned normative PQ EOTF; display peak remains independent

tone_map.evidence: P approximation, not BT.2390 or vendor firmware
tone_map.formula: K=kP; f(Y)=Y for Y≤K, else K+(P−K)*(1−exp(−(Y−K)/(P−K)))
tone_map.rgb: Scale by f(Y)/Y, then project excessive RGB toward equal-channel white.

abl.area_relation: For neutral requested window on black: APL_request = fraction × requested_window_nits. Area equals normalized APL only when amplitude=P0.
abl.current_source: All shipped profiles inherit abl_source=emitted: read mean after panel clipping; demand mode is separately supported and opt in.
abl.opt_in_source: abl_source=demand reads upstream requested linear luminance after spatial processing and before limiting.
abl.dynamics: abl_response_ms=0 and tracking=0 in shipped profiles; separate attack/release, thermal and static-logo controllers are not modeled.
abl.power: abl_power_budget_nits=0 disables weighted-nit proxy; it is not watts.

response.t10_90_ms: ln(9)*tau_ms, only in same measurement domain
response.first_frame: settled, not a black→white response test
response.state: unblurred response endpoint retained before BFI/pursuit

overdrive.formula: u_OD=clip(u+k*(u−q_start),0,ceiling) for a short prefix, then u
overdrive.current: gain=0 for all; LCD prefix duration=2 ms, OLED=0
overdrive.limits: P optical surrogate; measured voltage/transition LUT and full inverse-ghosting dynamics NR

bfi.current: duty=1; optional centered rectangular pulse when subframe integration enabled
bfi.limits: No measured scanout/PWM/BFI pulse waveform or supported retail-mode claim

temporal.implementation: integration_samples=1 is legacy endpoint+7 shifts. Gallery separately uses 16 analytic subframe response samples.

memc.implemented: Exact rational PTS; known translation or known layered masks/depths; explicit cuts and safe source-hold fallback before display stages.

viewing_angle.evidence: Every shipped M10 angular value is P placeholder. Complete generic-profile fits and OLED measured gains/spectra are NR.
viewing_angle.support: Combined center-ray angle 0–45 degrees, outside rejected; this is a synthetic exploration bound, not measured support.
viewing_angle.geometry: cos(theta)=cos(horizontal)*cos(vertical); unsigned symmetry and azimuth independence are P assumptions.
viewing_angle.emissive: Emitted RGB multiplied only by RGB angular gain, with no LCD leakage.

fixed_100_nit_backlight_example.evidence: D using P model endpoints, isolated mechanisms (ABL/sharpen/optics/temporal disabled)

limits: No per-pixel seat geometry or IPS corner glow

host_display.evidence: Research proposal; no Mac renderer or host calibration implemented
host_display.current_preview: 8-bit sRGB default maps 100 simulated nits to code1 and clips higher values; no browser nit guarantee.
host_display.shared_scale: L_preview=s*L_T with one scale shared across all TVs and compared times
host_display.hard_clip: L_preview=min(L_T,L_H): lower values retained, distinctions above host limit lost

example.evidence: D/P conditional example, not measured host

edr.W: measured luminance of EDR(1,1,1), current SDR/UI white
edr.H: current admissible EDR component maximum; current and positive reference headroom considered

example.evidence: D/P conditional example; not a calibrated host

edr.limits: EDR1 is relative white, not universal nits; potential headroom is not current/reference headroom. Lowering W cannot raise physical panel peak.

unmatched: host black floor and local dimming halos

evidence_grades.M: Published measurement on a named specimen under recorded conditions
evidence_grades.D: Calculation from stated inputs with retained method/source
evidence_grades.P: Proposed model, synthetic preset, fitting choice or interpolation
evidence_grades.NR: No verified numerical reference, unidentified parameter or unknown condition
evidence_grades.not_applicable: Mechanism/field does not apply; distinct from unknown
rules: An interpolation between M nodes is P.
A measured peak does not establish sustained luminance or timing.
Nearby named-TV measurement does not turn a generic parameter into M.

named_measurements.luminance_evidence: Each numeric node is M in versioned sidecars; null entries retain NR.
